firm_data.firm_description: Pearl Cohen Zedek Latzer Baratz is an international law firm with affiliated local firms providing legal advice with commercial impact. The firm has a commitment to innovation and excellence, serving innovation-driven enterprises.
notable_facts: Offices in Tel Aviv, New York, Boston, San Francisco, and London.
Ranked by Chambers Global in IT & Data Protection (Band 1).
Provides integrated legal advice in commercial law, litigation and intellectual property, covering the US, Israel, together with aspects of European and Eurasian law.
